reviews.text: Didi is very attentive and careful with the dogs. You can tell he loves what he does and does it very well; he's experienced. Very reliable and punctual.

Diego is an excellent dog walker! He is very attentive and careful, treating each dog individually and respecting their needs, limitations, and personality. He is kind, polite, patient, and very affectionate with our little ones. Our dogs adore him, and we feel completely at ease knowing they are in Diego's care. We highly recommend him!

I found Diego while searching for dog walkers on Google, and now he's one of my dogs' favorite people! He's very attentive and careful with my little ones, especially my 14-year-old senior. He adapts the walk to the dog's needs and keeps me updated on everything. You can tell he loves what he does, loves dogs, and mine love him too. I highly recommend him! :)

Diego helped me when I was in São Paulo on a personal trip and had nowhere to leave my dog. From the moment of initial contact, he was always transparent through messages. The pet was welcomed for a few hours at his home, where I felt at ease.
Thank you, and until next time.
